notes: TEST build. Brushes v3 — five parts: tool (what touches — hairs, solid, knife, sponge, rag, finger — of any shape: round, flat, star, polygons, letters like K, your own mask), texture (what the tool leaves in the paint), surface (paper, canvas weave), paint (ten numbers, colours, unmixed), hand. A solid shape drags like a knife; with entropy every stroke has its own live tip. Plus v2.1: soft varied dry strips, colours in the brush, a covering white, flatter thick paint.
